addressedBlockers.issue: A foreign manifest edit could remain at exported owned fields while exact-owned Source mirrors rolled back, creating Source/manifest drift.
addressedBlockers.resolution: A foreign attempted dependency blocks every automatic rollback; all landed fields are preserved pending fresh native reconciliation. Known-owned recovery rechecks the dependent set before every scoped restore and stops on a new foreign observation or CAS exception.

addressedBlockers.issue: Missing/unreadable recovery files or final checks outside the recovery try could bypass immutable failure evidence.
addressedBlockers.resolution: Read failures during ownership or recovery preserve pending evidence and stop. All final Source/manifest/HEAD assertions now execute within failure handling.
